      Approach

      Why HEX

      We don’t work in silos or with a team of 20 designers. We keep delegation lean and collaborate with a network of independent creatives as each project needs. A few qualities and processes that give us an edge over other agencies, studios and freelancers:

      01Small on purpose

      We take real interest in our clients and love to learn the small details that make a company special. We’re not a massive studio, and we place high priority on building lasting relationships.

      02We think together

      We don’t do echo chambers and single-person Figma files. Our work is vetted, scribbled on and commented on by other creatives, so you get the full exposure of working with a collaborative studio.

      03First principles thinking

      Our process is a product of years of iteration. Each stage was built from the ground up by questioning the design process. We’ve killed the waste.

      04We’ve led massive revamps

      We’ve led large and complex brand, web and product projects and are comfortable in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.

      05We learn and adapt

      We’re always working on new shit for new people. We’ve learned how to learn, and we adapt quickly to what each project needs.

      06We will not waste your time

      Our goal is to deliver the highest quality output in the least amount of time. We move fast, and with clarity, every single time.

          FAQ
          Questions and answers
          
      
          
        
          
          
          How do we get your best work?
          Our best work comes when clients stay on top of feedback loops and client-side deliverables. Acting fast and making decisions is what makes the difference in hitting timelines and shipping something high quality.
          
          
          How do we communicate?
          We’re big fans of asynchronous communication and like to use Slack and Loom for project management and feedback. We can also schedule weekly meetings to walk through progress and deliverables. Usually we start with calls while we learn to work together, then move to async updates via Loom as the project progresses.
          
          
          How do you charge?
          We bill at $7.5K per week, tied to specific deliverables and timelines.
